verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own docs claim ligatures and font fallback, and a community user lists ligatures as a reason for choosing it over Alacritty, so two of the story's three elements are covered. Fine-grained font tuning is not evidenced beyond a passing mention of changing font size; one user's vague complaint about lacking font configuration and another's report of worse Pragmata rendering on Linux are not concrete enough to dispute the documented claims. Missing for 10: documented fine-grained font tuning (weights, harfbuzz features, line height, per-font rules), in-depth first-party font docs, and hands-on corroboration that fallback works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use programming fonts with ligatures, fallback fonts, and fine-grained font tuning
